title: What AI do you recommend to create sprites for a 2D fighting game?
author: Nearby_Ad4786
selftext: Having the IDLE sprite I want to create the rest of  themoveset (no pixel art)

comments.author: OkRelative8104
comments.body:
I experienced a bit with generalistic AIs (both gemini  and chatgpt), haven't yet tested dedicated models that do only that. 
Had okish results for simple things like walk  jump animations.
My workflow is first to ask the llm to generate an optimizd prompt for that (eg , help me build a prompt to create a spritesheet from a starging image..  ensure the first frame is rhe uploaded image ...).
It then generates a prompt and highlights which parts to adapt in the prompt to your use case.
Then repast that in a new convo and upload the starting sprite.
In my experience, it struggles to exactly align the sprites within the sheet, so some manual cropping aligning is still necessary.
Happy to hear more about other experiences.

replies.author: Nearby_Ad4786
replies.body: Its more or less my actual workflow. The "meta AI": ask an AI what to say to another AI

comments.author: beelllllll
comments.body:
I'm biased because it's my product but you can try [https://www.autosprite.io/](https://www.autosprite.io/) 

You just upload the base character image and you can get all the animations you want, punch, kick, walk, run, and you can make custom too.

let me know if it works for you and if you have any feedback

comments.author: GalacticaTheDev
comments.body: If you have decent hardware, I recommend using WAN model locally in ComfyUI or a similar UI. Then use the specific LORAs from Civitai that were created for side-scrolling view animations.
